stats.crackRate: Percentage of hashes successfully cracked so far, not a speed/rate of cracking.

jobs.autoRefreshOn: Label for the auto-refresh toggle button when auto-refresh is on.
jobs.autoRefreshOff: Label for the auto-refresh toggle button when auto-refresh is off.

recentCracks.copy: 'Plaintext' is the recovered password itself (hashcat terminology for the decrypted value).

autoRefresh.on: 'Live' means this dashboard is auto-refreshing; unrelated to a job's 'Running' status.
autoRefresh.off: 'Paused' means auto-refresh is paused; unrelated to a job's own 'Paused' status.
